goal: Implement Spec Kit T024: a reporter can list and view only their reports and edit the six fields of an own open report
acceptance_criteria: Reporter list shows only own reports newest first with title, status and creation time; an empty state links to creation
Reporter can view own report and edit all six fields only while it is open; valid save retains owner and status
Invalid or oversized edits show field errors and preserve entered text; Python textarea line endings normalize to LF so unchanged saves do not alter the snippet
Other users and non-Reporters cannot read or edit a report through URL or direct mutation; RLS denies closed-report edits
